newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi singer escapes murder attempt - Babel.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi singer escapes murder attempt - Babel.

text.p: Iraq's most popular singer, Kazem al-Sahir, escaped a murder attempt while driving to Baghdad from Jordan to sing for President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday, Babel newspaper said on Saturday.
It said Sahir, who has been living outside Iraq for the last two years, was shot at on Wednesday by bearded assailants on the desert highway between the Jordanian border and Baghdad.

The paper -- which is owned by Uday -- did not say whether Sahir was wounded, but said Sahir attended and sang in the party organised later on to celebrate the recovery of Uday who was seriously injured in an assassination attempt last December.
The paper published a picture showing Sahir standing between Uday and his younger brother Quesy, saying it had been taken during the celebration after the incident.
Earlier this month, Iraq announced that Uday had left hospital in Baghdad after making a "full recovery."
